name: hand-brush-write-on
title: Brush Write-on
description: Chữ hay hình vẽ hiện ra từng nét theo đúng thứ tự viết, nét sau bắt đầu ngay khi nét trước xong.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Strokes drawn in writing order, each 200-400 ms ease-in-out, 60 ms between strokes, ~1500 ms total (recipe). Demo: 4 polyline strokes (9 px, round caps and joins), stroke i drawn by length from 0.2 + 0.5 i s over 400 ms ease-in-out. Params: duration mỗi nét (0.2–0.4 s) · gap (60 ms) · width. Strokes are drawn in document order, so put them in writing order.
